evidence: Injected UI fixtures; no broker-backed account, fill, or profitability evidence.

checks.name: Guest broker setup survives archive outage, supports keyboard and mobile, and cannot submit trades
Google sign-in reaches only the existing scoped OAuth boundary
Verified identity displays reported paper accounts without broker-ready or trading claims
Expired and future-dated reports do not show reporting state; revoked devices remain hidden
Anonymous or mismatched owners cannot view account evidence or authorize a trade
Direct link is unavailable until configured; callback text never grants account access
Verified account access is masked, independent from the computer, and withdrawn on refresh failure
Expired verification and reauthorization requirements cannot appear connected
Moomoo consent begins only on an explicit click with a top-level POST and no token URL
Disconnect removes the direct link without changing the paired computer or starting a runner
Focus cannot cancel an in-flight disconnect or restore its older connected state
